name: dsh-vision-insights-plugin
description: LinkHealth Vision Insights for DeepSeek Harness: the DSH consumer side of the OpenVINO edge-vision architecture. Talks to a vision-insight service (pose estimation + deterministic rules on an edge pipeline) over a baseUrl config entry; today ships the deterministic assess_exercise_form check, tomorrow a query_vision_events tool over the insight store. Never bundles the inference model itself.
